"Praise be to the Great One, everlasting be the harmony..." The majestic Charmony resonates within the parliament hall. "Miss Robin, thank you for your singing, but did Bronze Melodia truly... abandon the Path of Harmony..." A Dreamchaser who once prayed to Sunday finds her, her face twisted in agony. She wants so desperately to comfort the helpless, lost soul just as her brother used to do, but even the most beautiful song feels hollow and powerless right now. "Miss Robin, did the Harmony make Dreamflux Reef turn out like this?" "Miss Robin, don't they always treat everyone as family?" The children from the choir crowd around her, laughing and playing, but their innocent questions leave her completely at a loss. Looking into those bright, shining eyes, she can only pull them into her arms in silence. "Never seen you in this state before..." At the Dreamjolt Hostelry, she accepts a soothing blend from Siobhan, allowing the bitter, slightly tart flavor overtake across her palate. "Once, I understood that I sang for Harmony, but now, I cannot even discern how much further I can walk..." Siobhan gave her shoulder a gentle pat. "This isn't your burden to carry." She shakes her head, "But when I cannot even bring myself to believe, how can I sway anyone else?" "You know, your brother used to come here for a drink from time to time, too." "My brother?" "He always sat in the shadows, looking just as troubled as you do now. Then one day, he penned a line in the lounge guestbook and never came back..."
